messages.subject: SCRbook request
parts:
Hi,

I'm a grad student searching for answers.  I was unable to find the SCR group, but I'm hoping to get help with some data from the scrbook package.  I would like to see the code for "jaguarDataCh11", but as far as I can tell, it's not available within the package itself.  If anyone could provide me with some guidance, it would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,

Melissa

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: SCRbook request
parts:
Hi Melissa,

Here is a link to the SCR list: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/spatialcapturerecapture

We never got around to publishing the analysis of the jaguar data, which is why that dataset isn't included in the R package. However, you could contact Agustin Paviolo to see if he would be willing to share it. 

Richard
